h1: The Next Frontier Will Be Synthesis

p: A glider is five cells. Collide enough of them and you can build a computer. We are building AI the same way: small parts with one job each, made to be combined.

a: Salo and Törmä, “What can oracles teach us about the ultimate fate of life?” (2022)
Eric S. Raymond, “The Glider: Proposal for a Hacker Emblem”
